{{Quote|A bad action can only create a worse reaction... Those are the principles we live by here on Islakon... No one is closer to the laws of cause and effect than we.|Primor|<ref name="SW74" />}}
The '''Inleshat''' were a [[Water/Legends|water]]-breathing [[Species/Legends|race]] indigenous to [[Drexel II]]. Due to a natural disaster, a group of mysterious [[spacefaring benefactors]] relocated them to [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]], within the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]. On this planet, the Inleshat became part of the [[Iskalonian]] [[The School|School]], a community of unrelated aquatic species who shared a unique cultural identity.

With time, the Inleshat became the dominant species within the School. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an eldery Inleshat named [[Primor (Inleshat)|Primor]] had become the spiritual leader of the Iskalonians.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Like life in a fishbowl.''"<br />"''We know we are "fish", Lando... but what is a bowl?|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Primor|<ref name="SW74" />}}
A [[Water/Legends|water]]-breathing [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="SWG1" /> the Inleshat were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Fish/Legends|fishes]], and they hatched from [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. They were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape. They had a torso with a head, two arms and two legs.<ref name="SW74" /> They usually had three digits on each of their webbed hands,<ref name="SWG1" /> though some individuals were known to have four or even five fingers. Most Inleshat were tall and muscular. The species had two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]]: male and female. Male individuals sometimes sported tendrils that descended from the cheekbones and chin in the manner of fleshy "beards". Females were physically distinguished by their [[Breast/Legends|breasts]] and thinner build.<ref name="SW74" />

[[File:Inleshat.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Inleshat would suffocate in the open air.]]
The top of the Inleshat's heads were covered with long, silky [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="SWG1" /> ranging in tone from [[Color/Legends|white]] to green, and a marked V-shaped growth of hair descended towards the center of their foreheads. Their [[Nose/Legends|noseless]] faces featured wide, pupilless [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the color yellow, red, blue, or green.<ref name="SW74" /> They had poor eyesight out of the water, but their long and pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]] could hear underwater sounds from [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away.<ref name="SWG1" /> The Inleshat also possessed a set of white, properly lined-up teeth that made up a brilliant smile.<ref name="SW74" />

The Inleshat were water-breathers, which means they had the natural ability to extract dissolved [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] from water. When taken out of the water for too long, they could not breath air and would die from an abnormally low amount of oxygen in their body. In the event of prolonged exposure to open air, Inleshat wore tanks filled with water.<ref name="SW74" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|No one should be dry on a lovely day like this!|Mone|<ref name="SW74" />}}
The Inleshat comprised the majority of the [[The School|School]], the interracial Iskalonian society. They were a spiritual and principled people, ready to defend a cause they knew to be upright.<ref name="SWG1" /> Highly political beings, they were concerned with the common good. Even the young Inleshat named [[Mone]], who was considered an "irresponsible pleasure-skeer", spent much of his time trying to content others.<ref name="SW74" />

Members of this species were easy-going and friendly to strangers, although in a way that could seem awkward to other races. When Mone greeted the heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], he splashed [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] with seawater, thinking the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] must have been hot and miserable with all that fur. Chewbacca first saw this behavior as an outrage, and both his friends [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had to hold him down before he fell upon the poor water-breather. Much to the amazement of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] like Leia Organa, the Inleshat did not have the concepts of shyness or physical privacy. The lovers Mone and Kendel would hug and exchange sweet words in public, with no shame or embarrassment whatsoever.<ref name="SW74" /> Similarly, the concept of spying was a foreign idea on Iskalon.<ref name="SWG1" />

Despite possessing their own [[Iskalonian (language)|Iskalonian]], which they shared with other races within the School, most Inleshat commoners could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Standard]] fluently.<ref name="SW74" />

==History==
The Inleshat evolved in the seas of Drexel II, located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of cataclysms on Drexel II put its inhabitants, the Inleshat, in jeopardy. When all seemed lost, an [[Spacefaring benefactors|unidentified species]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travelers reached out to the Inleshat and helped them relocate to another planet. Now established on the world of Iskalon, the Inleshat united with other aquatic species and contributed to building the Iskalonian School, the cultural fusion of seventeen distinct races that made up the Iskalonian civilization.<ref name="SWG1" />
